utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh good, I’m a little out of the loop—did we ever fill that Wednesday driver spot?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I’m a bit late to this, but I don’t have the carpool details in front of me. If you want, I can check and get back to you right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks — I’d really appreciate it if you could check and let me know.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, 7:30 still works for me — I can take the first leg if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, thanks, Mara — I’ll note you for the first leg at 7:30. Just send me your pickup spot and I’ll keep the rest organized.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — I’ll send over my pickup spot shortly. Thanks for keeping it organized, Opal.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem — I’ll keep it organized and make the handoff easy. Tuesdays and Thursdays at 8:15 still work for me.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh great, thanks Gus — that works for me too. I’ll keep Tuesday and Thursday at 8:15 in mind.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — I’ll stick with Tuesdays and Thursdays at 8:15, then. If anything changes, just let me know and I’ll adjust.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks — 8:00 sounds good to me, but let me double-check my schedule before I fully commit.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll share 8:00 with everyone and keep the carpool plan coordinated. Let me know once you’ve checked your schedule.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — I’ll check and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Kira — weekday mornings after 8:30 still work best for me, and early afternoons can be a backup. I’ll keep track of the sign-up and supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so after 8:30 on weekdays works for you — can you confirm if a little earlier is ever okay, or should we stick with that?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Stick with after 8:30 on weekdays if we can — a little earlier is tough for me. I’ll keep tracking the sign-up and supplies on my end.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word today and see who’s in for the 7:30 carpool.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — 7:30 works for me, and I’ll keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks — I’ll ask around and keep you in the loop as soon as I hear who’s interested.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep — Tuesday and Wednesday are swapped, and pickup stays at 8. If that works, we’re all set.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that helps — I’ll update the schedule and make sure everyone knows Tuesday and Wednesday are swapped. Thanks for confirming the 8 o’clock pickup.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks Pia — appreciate you updating it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I don’t think it’s settled yet, but I can check with everyone and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — please send me the pickup time and who’s in the carpool once you check, and I’ll confirm after I have the details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check with everyone and send you the pickup time and the carpool list as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — I’ll keep it organized and check who can do weekday mornings and late afternoons. If you have any exact times, send them over and I’ll note them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: 8:00 still works for me. Let me know where you want to meet.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — let’s meet at the corner by the park at 8:00, and I’ll confirm the rest of the carpool details with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — just send me the timing when you’ve got it, and I’ll slot in wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess — I’ll send the timing over as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thanks — I’ll keep an eye out and be ready to jump in wherever needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — what time should I be ready tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. I’ll pass along the final time as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, just let me know as soon as you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, 7:30 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, then I’ll plan on 7:30 from my place on Maple Street. I’ll let you know right away if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll be ready at 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll ask around today and let you know who’s interested in the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, can you confirm by tonight who’s in? I just want to make sure we’ve got a headcount.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m still waiting to confirm the date, Sam, but I’ll let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still good to do the carpool tomorrow. I’ll let you know the time as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks — once you hear back, let me know and I’ll pass the carpool time along to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll update you as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, same spot each time works fine. Thanks, Gus — that keeps it nice and simple.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — same spot works for me too. What time should we plan to meet?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s stick with 8:15, same as before. That keeps the routine easy.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — could you send me the pickup time and who’s in the carpool? I’ll confirm once I have the details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll send the pickup time as soon as Mara confirms it, and I’ll include who’s in the carpool too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, I’ll wait for Mara’s confirmation and then I can confirm. Please send the time and names when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I hadn’t heard the latest—how’s the carpool working out?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, 7:30 still works for me. Just let me know if that changes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks — I’ll pass that along if I hear any updates.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can check with everyone and sort out who’s driving this week, then I’ll let you know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Jules — that’d be great. Just send me the pickup time and who’s in once you’ve got it, and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check with everyone and send you the pickup time and names as soon as I’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Pia — I’m a bit scattered, but if Tuesday and Wednesday are swapped and pickup stays at 8, I’m good.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — I’ll confirm Tuesday and Wednesday are swapped and keep pickup at 8. I’ll circle back once I’ve checked the other drivers.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks Pia — just let me know once the other drivers are set.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks — I’ll keep track of the pickup spots and times; just send me the names and addresses when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll send the names and addresses next.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thank you — I’ll organize the pickup spots and times once you send them over.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam — I really appreciate you helping with the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can pick everyone up at my place on Maple Street and leave around 7:30. If anything changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds great, Sam. Thanks for keeping me posted — I really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — just let me know the days and I can fill in where needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Tess — could you cover Wednesdays? If so, what time works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wednesdays work for me — late afternoon or around 5:30 is best. Just send the exact pickup time when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: 8:00 still sounds good to me — I just want to make sure I’ve got the meeting spot right before I say yes for sure.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yep — the meeting spot is still the same, and I’ll keep track of the carpool sign-up and supplies on my end.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Cleo — that helps. I’ll double-check my schedule, and if everything lines up, I’ll confirm the carpool spot with you.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I can keep it organized and make the handoff easier. Tuesdays and Thursdays at 8:15 still work for me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — 8:15 on Tuesdays and Thursdays works for me too. I’ll plan on that and appreciate you keeping the handoff organized.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Glad to help, Mara — I’ll keep an eye out and make sure the handoff goes smoothly.
